en.title: U.S. Supreme Court authorizes resumption of deportations to third countries
en.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court has authorized the resumption of deportations to third countries.

en.summary: Coverage of news from Tuesday, the 29th, is available for EPTV 2's Ribeirão and Franca programming.

stories.title: Nunes Marques manda incluir Zema e candidatos do Novo a governos estaduais em debates eleitorais

en.title: Nunes Marques orders inclusion of Zema and Novo party candidates for state governorships in electoral debates
en.summary: A judicial decision has mandated that Zema and candidates from the Novo party running for state governor positions be included in electoral debates.

stories.title: Trump reúne CEOs de IA e anuncia compromisso para reforçar controles de segurança

en.title: Trump meets AI CEOs and announces commitment to strengthen security controls
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump met with executives from major artificial intelligence companies at the White House. The meeting resulted in a joint commitment from the companies to implement controls and audits to enhance their systems' security.

stories.title: Nunes Marques permite que Zema e outros candidatos do Novo participem de debates

en.title: Nunes Marques allows Zema and other Novo party candidates to participate in debates
en.summary: The president of Brazil's Superior Electoral Court granted the Novo party's request and reversed a previous court understanding to permit the party's candidates to participate in electoral debates.

stories.title: Suprema Corte autoriza Trump a deportar imigrantes para países terceiros

en.title: Supreme Court authorizes Trump to deport immigrants to third countries
en.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court authorized President Trump's government to resume deporting migrants to countries other than their own, without offering them the opportunity to learn about potential threats they may face.

stories.title: Fake news sobre Nossa Senhora chega aos palanques de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Fake news about Our Lady reaches campaign platforms of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: Misinformation concerning Our Lady has circulated on the campaign platforms of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Trump se reúne com líderes do setor de IA e diz ver ‘enorme esforço para autorregulação’

en.title: Trump meets with AI sector leaders and says he sees 'enormous effort for self-regulation'
en.summary: Trump held meetings with artificial intelligence industry leaders and commented on their self-regulation efforts.

stories.title: Quaest: Eduardo Paes lidera no Rio com 34%, seguido por Douglas Ruas, com 25%

en.title: Quaest: Eduardo Paes leads in Rio with 34%, followed by Douglas Ruas with 25%
en.summary: A Quaest poll shows former Rio de Janeiro mayor Eduardo Paes leading the state governorship race with 34% support five days before the first round of voting, with Douglas Ruas in second place at 25%.

stories.title: Pesquisa Quaest: Paes tem 34% e Ruas 25% no Rio de Janeiro no 1º turno

en.title: Quaest survey: Paes has 34% and Ruas 25% in Rio de Janeiro in first round
en.summary: A Quaest poll shows Eduardo Paes leading the Rio de Janeiro state governorship race with 34% support, ahead of Douglas Ruas at 25% in the first round of voting.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai a 36% em São Paulo, Lula a 30%, aponta Quaest

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro reaches 36% in São Paulo, Lula at 30%, says Quaest
en.summary: A Quaest poll released Tuesday shows presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro at 36% support among São Paulo voters, ahead of President Lula at 30%, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

stories.title: Quaest: Flávio amplia vantagem sobre Lula em SP; veja o desempenho dos presidenciáveis em 5 Estados

en.title: Quaest: Flávio widens lead over Lula in SP; see presidential candidates' performance in 5 States
en.summary: A Quaest poll shows President Lula has lost support in São Paulo, with senator Flávio Bolsonaro now leading by six percentage points. The gap between the two candidates has widened significantly since late August when they were nearly tied.

stories.title: Quanto custa carregar um autopropelido? Veja quanto a bateria pesa na conta de luz

en.title: How much does it cost to charge an electric vehicle? See how much the battery weighs on your electricity bill
en.summary: Electric vehicle charging costs consumers far less on their electricity bills than commonly believed. Electric bicycles led industry growth in Brazil's first half of 2026 with over 34,000 units produced.

stories.title: Azul contrai empréstimo de R$ 2,66 bilhões junto ao BNDES

en.title: Azul contracts R$ 2.66 billion loan from BNDES
en.summary: Airline Azul signed a definitive loan agreement with Brazil's development bank BNDES for up to R$ 2.66 billion in long-term financing. The company received an initial disbursement of approximately R$ 1.3 billion on Tuesday.

stories.title: Aneel nega recurso da Enel SP por perícia em processo que pode levar à perda da concessão

en.title: Aneel denies Enel SP appeal for expert evaluation in case that could lead to loss of concession
en.summary: Brazil's electricity regulator Aneel rejected Enel São Paulo's appeal against a decision that denied the company's request for expert technical evaluation. The evaluation is part of a process that could result in the loss of Enel's operating concession.

stories.title: Meta Incorporadora nasceu de uma meta de fazer o aluguel pagar os custos da empresa

en.title: Meta Incorporadora was born from a goal of making rental income cover company costs
en.summary: Meta Incorporadora emerged from founder Alexandre Souza Lima's objective to build a real estate portfolio generating enough rental income to cover the company's fixed expenses. The company maintains this strategy of retaining some assets rather than selling all developed properties.
